tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /snyan ngag mngon brjod brda gsar rnying gi rnam gzhag mdor bsdus blo gsal yid 'phrog ces bya ba bzhugs/
༄༅/ /snyan ngag mngon brjod brda gsar rnying gi rnam gzhag mdor bsdus blo gsal yid 'phrog ces bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /snyan ngag mngon brjod brda gsar rnying gi rnam gzhag mdor bsdus blo gsal yid 'phrog ces bya ba bzhugs/

na mo mañju shrī ye/ pad dkar bsil zer cha shas rgyas pa'i steng*/ /mtshar sdug lta bas mi ngoms 'jo sgeg can/ /tshig gi mchog sbyin nges ster bcom ldan ma/ /ngag dbang dbyangs can lha mos dge legs stsol/ /zhes mchod par brjod pa sngon du btang nas/ /snyan ngag mngon brjod brda gsar rnying gi rnam gzhag mdor bsdus zhig 'chad pa'i dang po la gsum/ lus dang*/ rgyan dang*/ skyon spong ngo*/ /dang po la gsum/ tshigs bcad lhug pa spel mar byas pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ sgra don dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ gong gi lus gsum po gang rung mdzes par byed pas na rgyan ces bya'o/ /gnyis pa dbye na gnyis te/ don rgyan dang*/ sgra rgyan no/ /dang po la so lnga yod de/ me long mar/ rang bzhin brjod dang dpe dang ni/ /gzugs can gsal byed skor ba dang*/ /'gog dang don gzhan bkod pa dang*/ /ldog pa can dang srid pa can/ /bsdus dang phul byung rab btags dang*/ /rgyu dang phra mo cha dang rim/ /dga' dang nyams ldan gzi brjid can/ /rnam grangs brjod dang kun tu phan/ /rgya che bsnyon dor sbyar ba dang*/ khyad par mtshungs par sbyor ba dang*/ /'gal dang skabs min bstod pa dang*/ /zol bstod nges par bsten pa dang*/ /lhan cig brjod dang yongs brjes shis/ /rab spel de nas dgongs pa can/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'di dag las so lnga'i dang po rang bzhin gyi rgyan ni/ brjod 'dod kyi dngos po gang yin pa de'i gnas tshul la sgro ma btags par rang bzhin drang por brjod pa zhig ste/ dbye na bzhi yod kyang*/ mtshon tsam dper na/ gsal rdzogs mtshan dpe'i dpal gyis mdzes pa'i sku/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos phung sgrog pa'i gsung*/ /mkhyen brtse'i rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i thugs/ /gang la mnga' ba 'dren mchog shākya'i tog /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa dpe rgyan ni/ tshig sbyor gang du bzhin/ ltar/ 'dra/ mtshungs sogs kyi sgras dpe dang dpe can phan tshun mtshungs par brjod pa zhig ste/

dbye na so gnyis/ mtshon dper/ rgya che'i chos tshul kun la byams mgon ltar/ /zab mo'i don la mkhyen pa'i gter chen bzhin/ /mdo rgyud kun la klu sgrub yab sras dang*/ /rab mtshungs chos kyi rgyal bo btsong kha ba/ /zhes pa lta bu/gsum pa gzugs can gyi rgyan ni/ tshig sbyor gang du dpe dang dpe can gnyis so sor ma phye bar dpe can dpe'i gzugs su bkod nas brjod pa zhig ste/ dbye na/ nyi shu/ thabs shes rlung gi shing rtas nyes drangs te/ /tshogs gnyis shar ri'i rtse nas mngon par 'phags/ /mkhyen brtse'i gzi 'od 'bar ba'i snang ba can/ /rgyal tshab smra ba'i nyi ma gang de rgyal/ /zhes pa lta bu/ bzhi ba gsal byed kyi rgyan ni/ gsal byed kyi tshig thog mtha' bar gsum gang rung na gnas pas ngag dang don gzhan gsal bar byed pa zhig ste/ dbye na lnga/ pad+mo'i gnyen gyis chu skyes gzhon nu'i tshul/ /ri bong can gyis 'od dkar kun da'i kha/ / gtan tshigs rigs pas gzhung lugs kun gyi sgo/ / rigs gnas 'dis ni mkhas blun khyad par 'byed/ /ces pa lta bu/ lnga ba skor ba'i rgyan ni/ tshig sbyor gang gi thog mtha' bar gsum gang rung du don dang tshig dang gnyis ka dang yi ge lta bu la'ang bskor te brjod kyang zlos pa'i skyon med pa zhig ste/ dbye na gsum/ nam mkha'i khams gyi mtha' ni rnam par dben/ /ji snyed shes bya'i mtha' yi tshad kyang bral/ /rgya mtsho'i gting mtha'i tshad ni dpag par dka'/ /rang bzhin stong ba'i gting mtha' rnyed par dkon/ /zhes pa lta bu/ drug pa 'gog pa'i rgyan ni/ tshig sbyor gang du 'gog byed kyi tshig gang gis rang gi dgag bya 'gog pa zhig ste/ dbye na nyer gsum/ sngon tshe thub dbang mchog gis tshigs bcad tsam/ /bstan pa yis kyang grol ba mang srid na/ /deng dus mang thos rtse gcig yun ring du/ /'bad pas bsgrubs kyang mi grol 'di ci zhig /ces pa lta bu/ bdun pa don gzhan bkod pa ni/

brjod don 'ga' zhig sngon du bkod nas de 'dra ba'i sgrub byed zhig rjes su brjod pa ste/ dbye na brgyad/ ma gsol bar yang byams brtses lus can 'gro/ /nges par rjes su 'dzin pa sangs rgyas te/ /nyin mor byed pas chu skyes gzhon nu'i tshal/ /legs par smin par byed pa rang bzhin nyid/ /ces pa lta bu/ brgyad pa ldog pa can ni/ brjod bya'i dngos po gnyis sngar mtshungs par brjod nas slar khyad par cung zad yod par ston pa zhig ste/ dbye na bzhi/ mtha' yas 'gro ba'i phan bde bsgrub pa'i ched/ /thugs bskyed rdzogs sangs rgyas kun mtshungs gyur kyang*/ /lhag par cher snyigs lnga bdo'i lus can rnams/ /rjes 'dzin bcom ldan shākya seng ge'i zhabs/ /ces pa lta bu/ dgu ba srid pa can ni/ dngos po gang rgyu la ma bltos par 'byung srid par ston pa lta bu zhig ste/ dbye na gsum/ smra byed lce yis ma brjod ca co sgrogs/ /bzhon rkang gshog pa med par rtag tu 'gro/ /phan gnod sems bral skom sel rgyu lam gcod/ /bsgyur bcos ma byas mdog sngo dbyar gyi chu/ /zhes pa lta bu/ bcu ba bsdus brjod ni/ brjod 'dod dpe can zhig brjod byar bsdus nas de mtshungs kyi dpe dngos su brjod pa zhig ste dbye na gsum/ mtha' yas 'dod rgu'i 'byung gnas dpag bsam shing*/ /yongs por rang dgar rgyu ba'i blun po 'ga'/ /chu shing 'khyog po dag la skyabs bcas kyang*/ /'dod don ma thob phongs pa'i sdug bsngal myong*/ /zhes pa lta bu/ 'dis dam pa bor nas dman pa bsten pa zhig bsdu/ bcu gcig pa phul byung ni/ brjod bya'i dngos po de la brjod 'dod kyi dbang gis bsngags pa lhag par byas pa zhig ste/ dbye na bzhi/ thugs rje'i bdag nyid pad dkar 'dzin pa'i dpal/ /dbyangs can bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i rnam dpyod la/ /ma lus rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen pa yang*/ /gcig tu bsdus kyang ji bzhin mtshon mi nus/

/zhes pa lta bu/ bcu gnyis pa rab btags sam rab rtog ni/ dngos po gang gi gnas tshul de la gzhan du sgro btags nas brjod pa zhig ste/ dbye na gsum/ nyin byed dbang bo mkha' la shar ba'i tshe/ /pad+mo'i tshal rnams dga' ba'i 'dzum ston zhing*/ /mun pa stugs po skrags nas gzhan du bros/ /bsil ba'i gdung ba'ang ring du 'gro snyam sems/ /zhes pa lta bu/ bcu gsum pa rgyu'i rgyan ni/ brjod 'dod kyi dngos po de la rgyu khyad par ba zhig yod par ston pa ste/ dbye na gsum/ gro nas la sogs sa bon yongs btab par/ /ston dus 'bras bzang rdzogs par smin pa'i rkyen/ /than ser gegs med chu lud drod gsher sogs/ /legs par tshang ba'i lhan cig byed pa nyid/ /ces pa lta bu/ bcu bzhi ba phra mo'i rgyan ni/ lus ngag sogs kyi brda'i rnam 'gyur phra mo zhig gis don gzhan go bar byed pa zhig ste/ dbye na gnyis/ skyon dang bral phyir bsil zer rgyas pa'i steng*/ /'gro kun 'dren phyir shel gyi 'phreng ba dang*/ / thugs rje'i rang bzhin nyid phyir pad dkar mchog /'dzin mdzad 'phags pa lo ki shwa rar 'dud/ /ces pa lta bu/ bco lnga ba cha'i rgyan ni/ /bstod pa ltar byas nas smad pa'am smad pa ltar byas nas bstod pa'i cha gnyis ka brjod pa zhig ste/ dbye na gnyis/ longs spyod dpal gyis 'byor ba'i dbus gnas shing*/ /rnam mang blun rmongs 'khor gyis gtsug gis bsten/ /zang zing 'du 'god la mkhas chos kyi rje/ /gang de khyod kyi 'di phyi gnyis kyi skyabs/ /zhes pa lta bu/ bcu drug pa rim pa can ni/ dngos po 'ga' zhig sngon du brjod nas de dag gi khyad par rim pa bzhin du rjes su brjod pa ste/ rgyal yum sgrol ma rje btsun dbyangs can ma/ /sdug bsngal las skyob dag gi dpal rab ster/ / gdugs dkar rnam rgyal 'phags ma 'od zer can/ /gdon srung tshe sbyin 'jigs pa'i tshogs las sgrol/ /zhes pa lta bu/

bcu bdun pa dga' ba can ni/ rgyu las 'bras bu khyad par can zhig thob pas dga' ba byung bar ston pa ste/ dbye na gnyis/ gtan tshigs rigs pa'i tshul la rab sbyangs pas/ /dngos po'i rang bzhin dngos stobs rigs pa yis/ /ma 'dres gsal bar mthong tshe bdag gi yid/ /sngon med dga' ba'i khyad par thob par gyur/ /zhes pa lta bu/ bco brgyad pa nyams ldan ni/ brjod don de yid du 'ong ba'am mi 'ong ba sogs kyi nyams dang ldan par brjod pa zhig ste/ dbye na brgyad/ rgyal bas rje btsun rnam par rgyal ma yi/ /gzungs kyi rtog pa brjod las phan yon gang*/ /rgya cher bstan pa'i rnga gsang snyan 'gyur dpal/ /thos pas rmad byung yid 'phrog gar gyis brel/ /ces pa lta bu/ bcu dgu ba gzi brjid can ni/ brjod bya'i don gang gzhan las dpa' ba'i gzi brjid can nam nga rgyal lta bur brjod pa zhig ste/ gzhung lugs mang thos kho bo'i mdun sa 'dir/ /rmongs rtul byis pa khyed cag lhag pa legs/ / dka' ba med par tshig dang don gyi gnad/ /ji bzhin bshad pa yis ni mgu bar bya/ /zhes pa lta bu/ nyi shu ba rnam grangs brjod pa ni/ rang gi 'dod don de dngos su ma brjod par de nyid 'grub pa'i phyir du rnam pa gzhan ltar brjod pa zhig ste/ 'chi med mchog ster mgon po tshe dpag med/ /rnam rgyal tshe sbyin yid bzhin 'khor lo yis/ /tshe dpal don du gnyer bar byed rnams la/ /dpag yas tshe yi dngos grub stsol zhes gsol/ /zhes pa lta bu/ nyer gcig pa kun phan ni/ bya ba 'ga' zhig gi tshe 'bad ma dgos par phan pa'i rkyen zhig byung bar ston pa ste/ blang dor gnas rnams rtogs phyir gzhung lugs la/ /brtson pas thos bsam byed tshe mkhyen pa'i dbang*/ /rje btsun brtan pa'i 'khor los byin brlabs pas/ /ji snyed gsung rab tshogs kyi dgongs don rtogs/ /zhes pa lta bu/ nyer gnyis pa rgya che ba ni/ bsam pa'am sbyor ba rgya che bar ston pa zhig ste/

dbye na gnyis/ khams gsum za byed gshin rje gshed po yis/ /ma rung dgra dang bgegs kyi dpung tshogs kun/ /cig car za bar nus kyang snying rje yis/ /phal cher btang snyoms nyid du ci dgar bzhag /zhes pa lta bu/ nyer gsum pa bsnyon dor ni/ brjod bya'i dngos po gang la de ma yin no zhes bsnyon nas gzhan pa zhig tu brjod pa ste/ dbye na gsum/ blo bzang rgyal ba'i dbang bo btsong kha ba/ /byams brtse'i thugs dang ldan pa ga la zhig/ phas rgol lta ngan 'bum gyi srog rtsa kun/ /gcod par byed pa'i gshed ma nyid du gsal/ zhes pa lta bu/ nyer bzhi ba sbyar ba ni/ tshig gcig brjod bya'i don gnyis la sbyar rung ba zhig ste/ dbye na gnyis/ rab dkar kun tu mdzes shing yid du 'ong*/ /gdung ba rab sel snying la dga' ba bskyed/ /'khor gyi tshogs ldan phan phyir rnam par rgyu/ /gnyis skyes mchod pa'i 'os su gyur pa lags/ /ces pa lta bu/ 'di dbyangs can ma dang zla ba gnyis la 'jug go/ /nyer lnga ba khyad par brjod pa ni/ rgyu'i khyad par ma tshang yang bya ba byed nus par ston pa zhig ste/ dbye na lnga/ 'di byed snyam pa'i yid kyi kun slong dang*/ /'du shes med par 'khor 'das chos rnams kyi/ /bya byed skye 'gag blang dor sna tshogs pa/ /'thad pa rten 'brel chos nyid gang yin mtshar/ /zhes pa lta bu/ nyer drug pa mtshungs sbyor ni/ /brjod bya 'ga' zhig mtshungs par brjod pa ste/ dbye na gnyis/ chos rgyal dge ba'i bshes gnyen nyi zla zung*/ /gzhan la phan pa'i ched du 'jug par mtshungs/ /blun rmongs ba lang khyu dang ku ku ra/ /lto phyir kun nas 'bad par byed ces zer/ /zhes pa lta bu/ nyer bdun pa 'gal rgyan ni/ brjod bya'i don 'gal ba dag kyang lhan cig srid par ston pa zhig ste/ dbye na drug /rgyal kun yab tu gyur kyang gzhon nu'i tshul/ /the tshom dra ba bcad kyang glegs bam 'dzin/ /chags sdang bral yang 'gro la rab tu brtse/

/sdang dang mi ldan bdud kyi dpung tshogs 'joms/ /zhes pa lta bu/ nyer brgyad pa skabs min bstod pa ni/ bstod pa'i 'os sam skabs min yang rang gi 'dod don la bsams nas bstod pa'am bsngags pa lta bu zhig ste/ dbyangs can sgrub la brtson pa'i sgom bzlas kyis/ /nyin mtshan med par gdung ba'i tshul 'di las/ /ci dgar spyod cing nyal ba'i blun po dag/ tshe 'dir sdug bsngal cher med bde bar sems/ /zhes pa lta bu/ nyer dgu ba zol bstod ni/ yul 'ga' zhig la skyon ltar snang ba zhig brjod nas don la bstod pa zhig ste/ dbye na gsum/ dal med rang nyid mnar ba'i sdug bsngal gyis/ /nyin mtshan kun tu dpe 'dzin kha ton la/ /brtson pas 'jug pa'i ngal ba sten byed pa/ khyod kyis bde ba ci zhig 'thob snyam sems/ /zhes pa lta bu/ sum cu pa nges bstan ni/ dpes dpe can de la chos mtshungs ston pa lta bu zhig ste/ dbye na gnyis/ dwangs gsal chu gter me long dag pa'i ngos/ / sna tshogs gzugs kyi bkod pa cig car du/ /mngon sum lhang nger 'char bas rgyal kun gyi/ /ye shes gsal bar chos rnams snang bar ston/ /zhes pa lta bu/ so gcig pa lhan cig brjod pa ni/ /dngos po gang bya ba gang dang lhan cig brjod pa zhig ste/ dbye na gsum/ rta bdun bdag po shar dang lhan cig tu/ /chu skyes rnam par smin pa'i 'dab ma rgyas/ /blo bzang rgyal ba byon dang lhan cig tu/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i thub bstan kun nas dar/ /zhes pa lta bu/ so gnyis pa yongs brjes ni/ brjod bya'i dngos po phan tshun brjes pa ltar ston pa zhig ste/ brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i thugs rje'i 'phrin las kyis/ / rmongs pa'i yid dbang ma lus 'phrog byas te/ /gsung rab kun la lta ba'i rnam dpyod kyi/ /'dod don mchog tu ster bas bskal bzang byas/ /zhes pa lta bu/ so gsum pa shis brjod ni/ 'dod don la smon pa'am zhu ba zhig ste/ tshul 'dir 'bad pa las 'khrungs rnam dkar dges/

/gzur gnas blo gsal don du gnyer ba dag /chos la 'jug pa'i brtson pa lhur len cing*/ /'di phyi kun tu dge ba'i bkra shis shog /ces pa lta bu/ so bzhi ba rab spel ni/ rgyan mang po spel pa zhig ste/ mtshan dang dpe byad dpal gyis mdzes pa'i sku/ /tshangs pa 'bum gyi dbyangs ltar snyan pa'i gsung*/ /shes bya kun gzigs nyin mor byed pa'i thugs/ /gang la mnga' ba thub dbang las gzhan su/ /zhes pa lta bu ste rgyan bsres pa'o/ /de nas so lnga ba dgongs pa can gyi rgyan ni/ rtsom pa po'i bsam don ston pa zhig ste/ mtshon dper/ rang nyid legs par goms par bya phyir dang*/ / gzhan dag la yang phan par srid snyam ste/ /dam pa'i man ngag dag la brten nas ni/ /mdor bsdus go sla'i ngag gis ji bzhin bshad/ /ces pa lta bu'o/ /sngar gyi dbye ba de dag phal cher rtsa ba'i sgo nas yin gyi/ yan lag gi sgo nas ni shin tu mang ngo*// //gnyis pa sgra rgyan la gsum/ zung ldan gyi khyad par/ bya dka' ba/ dbyangs nges pa sogs so/ /dang po la drug /rkang ba'i thog ma na yod pa'i zung ldan/ gnas gzhan na yod pa'i zung ldan/ thog mtha' sbyar ba/ kun tu zung ldan/ bsres pa'i zung ldan/ bzlog pa'i zung ldan no/ /dang po la gsum/ bar ma chod pa/ chod pa/ chod cing ma chod pa'o/ /dang po la rkang ba dang po'i thog ma na yod pa sogs bco lnga yod kyang*/ 'dir mtshon dper/ rkang pa bzhi ka'i thog ma na yod pa tsam ni/ zab zab rigs pa smra ba yi/ /mkhas mkhas kun gyi mgo bo la/ /mdzes mdzes zhabs sen rnam 'god pa/ /nges nges kun mkhyen rgyal tshab rje/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa chod pa la thog ma'i zung ldan sogs bcu gsum yod kyang*/ dper rkang ba bzhi ka'i thog ma na yod pa tsam ni/ rgyal ba'i dgongs don ma lus pa/ /rgyal ba gnyis pas bkral ba bzhin/ /rgyal ba'i chos tshul kun 'dzin pa/ /rgyal sras mkhas grub chos kyi rje/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gsum pa chod cing mchod pa la gsum yod kyang*/

dper/ thog tha gnyis 'dra zhing bar ba gnyis kyang 'dra ba tsam ni/ 'khyug 'khyug glog 'phreng 'phro ba'i tshe/ /shar shar char pa 'bab pa dang*/ /shang shang chu rgyun dal gyis rgyu/ /'khyug 'khyug dbang po'i gzhu yang bkra/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa gnas gzhan na yod pa'i zung ldan la/ rkang ba bzhi ka'i dbus na yod pa sogs drug yod kyang*/ dper/ gnas gsum na yod pa la chod pa dang*/ /chod cing ma chod pa gnyis kyi dang po ni/ /blo chen rgyal kun blo gros chen po'i blo/ /blo ldan rgyal sras blo gsal 'jam dbyangs blo/ /blo gros 'gran bral blo bzang grags pa'i blo/ /blo dman nyan rang blo chung bdag gi blo/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ 'khyug 'khyug glog gi phreng ba ji bzhin 'khyug 'khyug spyan zur g.yo 'khyug 'khyug /ldem ldem lcugs phran ljon pa'i rtse ltar ldem ldem ral pa'i rtse ldem ldem/ /'dzum 'dzum pad+ma'i 'dab ma ji bzhin 'dzum 'dzum zhal gyi sgo 'dzum 'dzum/ /dkar dkar gangs kyi ri dbang lta bur dkar dkar dbyangs can mdog dkar dkar/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gsum pa thog mtha' sbyar ba ni/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi yum/ / yum mchog rje btsun rnam rgyal ma/ /ma gcig khyod la gsol btab tshe/ /tshe dang ye shes nges par stsol/ /zhes pa lta bu/ bzhi ba kun tu zung ldan la rkang ba bzlas pa/ tshigs bcad bzlas pa/ /zung ldan chen po gsum yod kyang*/ dper/ rkang ba bzlas pa tsam ni/ / 'dzam gling mkhas pa kun gyi rje/ /theg chen shing rta'i srog 'byed mkhan/ / 'dzam gling mkhas pa kun gyi rje/ /theg chen shing rta'i srol 'byed mkhan/ /zhes pa lta bu/ lnga ba bsres pa ni/ 'dzum 'dzum zhal gyi sgo mdzes mdzes/ /mdzes mdzes sku mchog mchog tu gsal/ /gsal dag thugs ni zab zab gang*/ /gang dang gang la'ang thogs med 'jug /ces pa lta bu/ drug pa ldog pa'i zung ldan la rkang ba bzlog pa sogs gsum yod kyang*/

dper/ rkang ba phyed bzlog pa tsam ni/ 'khrul pas bcings rnams bcings pas 'khrul/ /zhen par 'dod chags 'dod pas zhen/ /gang na yod tshe yod na gang*/ /'khor bar ring du ring bar 'khor/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa bya dka' la ba lang gcin/ kun 'khor/ phyed 'khor gsum ste gzhan du shes/ gnyis pa dbyangs sogs nges pa la gsum las/ dang po ni/ dper/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la/ /mchod do bstod do gsol lo brjod/ /dus kun gus 'dud lus btud zhu/ /bde legs ye shes nges ster byed/ /nyid kyis ji bzhin 'dir ni gzigs/ /zhes pa lta bu ste/ dbyangs lnga so sor nges pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ de tsam du mi mkho/ gsum pa gsal byed kyi yi ge bzhir nges pa ni/ dper/ rang rang re re rong rong rong*/ /lang lang ling ling long long long*/ /shang shang shor shor shig shig shig /tang tang ting ting tog tog tog /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /gsum pa skyon spong ba ni/ don nyams pa spong ba sogs bcu yod kyang*/ /rgyas par ni gzhan du shes par bya ste/ /'dir mang du dogs nas ma bris so// // ༈ na mo ār+ya tā ra ye/ gnyis pa mngon brjod bshad pa ni/ /rgyal ba kun mkhyen kun gzigs dang*/ /thams cad mkhyen dang thams cad gzigs/ / thub pa bde gshegs de bzhin gshegs/ /rnam 'dren bcom ldan rkang gnyis gtso/ /gnyis med gsung pa drang srong che/ /dus gsum mkhyen pa 'gro ba'i bla/ /chos kyi rgyal bo stobs bcu mnga'/ /sangs rgyas spyi yi mtshan du 'dod/ / shākya'i rgyal bo shākya'i tog /shākya seng ge go'u ta ma/ /bu ram shing ba zas gtsang sras/ /don kun grub pa shāka thub mtshan/ /mi pham mgon dang ma pham pa/ /rgyal tshab dam pa byams pa'i mtshan/ /'jam mgon ngag gi dbang phyug che/ /brtan pa'i 'khor lo blo gter mchog /zur phud lnga pa 'jam dbyangs mtshan/ /ngag dbang lha mo tshangs sras ma/ /sgra dbyangs lha mo mtsho byung ma/ /shes rab lha mo dbyangs can mtshan/

/mtho ris gnas dang skabs gsum gnas/ /gsum rtsen gnas la lha gnas ming*/ /'chi med bcud ldan bdud rtsi can/ /mkhar nyal gsum rtsen skabs gsum pa/ /legs bris tshig mda' mkha' la 'gro/ /sbyin skyes dgra sogs lha spyi'i ming*/ /skye rgu'i bdag po mi mjed bdag /gser mngal can dang gdong bzhi ba/ /'jig rten mes po lha las rgan/ /byed po rna ba brgyad pa dang*/ /rang byung la sogs tshangs pa'i ming*/ /srid med bu dang thag gu'i lto/ /gos ser can dang pad dkar mig /mi yi seng ge mi'u thung*/ /'jug pa bcu pa sbyin skyes dgra/ /mkha' lding rgyal mtshan gos gsum gnon/ /stobs ldan dgra sogs khyab 'jug ming*/ /yid srub bdag po mda' lnga pa/ /me tog mda' can lus med bdag /dga' ma'i bdag po dka' thub dgra/ /dga' rab dbang phyug 'dod lha'i ming*/ /khyu mchog rgyal mtshan u ma'i bdag / gangs ri'i bdag bo ral khur can/ /drag po 'phrog byed bde 'byung dang*/ / gtsug na zla ba mig gsum pa/ /dpal mgrin mgrin nag mgrin sngon can/ / gang gā 'dzin dang lha chen po/ /grong gsum mthar byed 'byung po'i bdag / dbang ldan bdag po rtse gsum can/ /mdung thogs la sogs dbang phyug ming*/ /legs bris dbang bo skabs gsum bdag /bde sogs bdag po mig stong can/ /dbang bo 'phrog byed rdo rje can/ /mchod sbyin brgya ba sprin la zhon/ /ko'u shi ka ri 'joms pa/ /shis brjod nyan sogs brgya byin ming*/ / sngon gyi lha dang dbang bo'i dgra/ khu ba'i slob ma sbyin skyes dang*/ /mchod sbyin dgra sogs lha min ming*/ /byin za rnyed za bsreg za dang*/ /skem byed mun 'joms 'bar ba can/ /rtse mo can dang rlung gi grogs/ /me dang me lha gnyis kyi ming*/ /dbyug 'dzin be con 'chang ba dang*/ /dus 'dzin mthar byed nyi ma'i bu/ ma mo'i rgyal bo chos kyi rgyal/ /'chi bdag la sogs gshin rje'i ming*/ /gdong bcu mgrin bcu laṅka'i bdag

/bden bral bdag po sha rjen za/ /sgra sgrogs la sogs srin po'i ming*/ /chu bdag char 'beb chu la spyod/ /chu ldan bsil 'dzin zhags pa can/ /mchog ster la sogs chu lha'i ming*/ /rtag 'gro dri len dri yi bzhon/ /myur 'gro mgyogs 'gro kun tu rgyu/ /reg ldan rlung dang rlung lha'i ming*/ /gnod sbyin bdag po mig gsum grogs/ /lus ngan bu dang ngal sos bu/ /nor sbyin gter bdag rnam sras ming*/ /bden bral bdag po gong du bshad/ /lha lam rlung lam sprin gyi lam/ /bya lam mkha' lam rgyu skar lam/ /kun gsal kun khyab go 'byed can/ /kun 'geg chu 'thongs nam mkha'i ming*/ /sprin lce 'khyug byed skad cig gsal/ /g.yo 'gul rnam bkra glog gi ming*/ /sprin bcud rgyun 'beb mkha' las 'bebs/ /sbrang char rgyun char chu'i zeg ma/ /sprin las byung sogs char ba'i ming*/ /dbang ba'i gzhu dang dbang bo'i mtshon/ /brgya byin mtshon cha lha yi mtshon/ /'ja' ris rab bkra 'ja' yi ming*/ /bsil byed sim byed 'od dkar can/ /ri bong 'dzin pa ri bong can/ /gnyis skyes dbang bo bsil zer can/ /bdud rtsi'i 'od can chu las skyes/ /mtshan mo'i nor bu mtshan mo'i mgon/ /bde 'byung gtsug rgyan cha shas gter/ /rgyu skar dbang bo rgyu skar bdag /pad dgra mtsho skyes kun da'i gnyen/ /tshes bdag la sogs zla ba'i ming*/ /nam mkha'i nor bu rta ljang can/ /srid pa'i mig dang 'od stong can/ /bcu gnyis bdag po gza' yi bdag /rta bdun bdag po pad+mo'i gnyen/ khyab gsal snang byed mi sbyin skyes/ /nyon mor byed pa tsha zer can/ /'od bkra la sogs nyi ma'i ming*/ /mun bral snang ldan nyin mo ste/ /mun ldan snang med mtshan mo'i ming*/ /myu gu'i dus dang sbrang ldan dus/ /'dod dus sos ka dpyid kyi ming*/ /char ldan char dus tsha ba'i dus/ /sprin 'byung sprin skye dbyar gyi ming*/ /'bras ldan dus dang smin pa'i dus/

/gser ldan ma ni ston gyi ming*/ kha ba'i dus dang grang ngar dus/ /bsil ldan ma ni dgun gyi ming*/ /dkar phyogs 'phel phyogs phyogs snga ma/ /gang phyogs zla stod yar ngo'i ming*/ /nag phyogs 'grib phyogs phyogs phyi ma/ /dmar phyogs zla smad mar ngo'i ming*/ /zla gang zla nya dkyil 'khor gang*/ /nya gang cha rdzogs bco lnga'i ming*/ /zla zad nyi zla lhan cig dus/ /stong mtha' gnam stong gnam gang ming*/ /dpyid dbyar ston dgun dus bzhi'i ming*/ /mgo rgyal mchu dbo nag pa zla/ /sa ga snon dang chu stod dang*/ /gro bzhin khrums dang tha skar zla/ /smin drug zla ba bcu gnyis so/ /nya skar byed pa'i cha nas bzhag /byi glang stag yos 'brug sbrul rta/ /lug sbrel bya khyi phag bcu gnyis/ /lo zla'i bdag po byed phyir bzhag /re rer shing me sa lcags chu/ /lnga lngar phye bas drug cu ste/ /rab byung zhes bya me yos nas/ /zad pa me stag bar drug cu/ /'phags pa'i yul du rnam par grag /legs byas bsod nams bde 'gro'i lam/ /blang bya bgo skal dge ba'i ming*/ /nyes byas nyes pa ngan 'gro'i lam/ /dor bya spang bya mi dge'i ming*/ /grol ba byang grol rnam grol zhi/ /nges legs myang 'das thar ba'i ming*/ /blo dang rnam dpyod rig pa dang*/ /blo gros bsam pa la sogs pa/ /shes pa'am shes rab ming du 'gyur/ /skyes bu shes ldan sems ldan dang*/ /srog ldan lus can 'gro ba dang*/ /tshe ldan srog chags la sogs pa/ / gang zag spyi'am bye brag ming*/ /gus 'dun mos pa dad pa ste/ /log sgrub mi mos ma dad ming*/ /rab bsngags legs sgrogs bstod pa ste/ /nyes brjod skur 'debs smod pa'i ming*/ /chu 'dzin chu gter chu klung bdag /rin chen 'byung gnas chu yi mdzod/ /zla ba'i ma ma rgya mtsho'i ming*/ /thur 'gro dal 'gro btung bya dang*/ /kun tu 'gro sogs chu spyi'i ming*/ khyab 'jug rkang ba lha yi rkang*/ /dza hu'i bu mo lam gsum 'gro/

/gaṅgā'i ming ste gzhan yang shes/ /'dam skyes chu skyes mtsho skyes dang*/ /'dab stong 'dab brgya ge sar can/ /ze'u 'bru can sogs pad ma'i ming*/ /chu skyes sngon po ut+pal te/ /sa mos kun da ku mud ming*/ /nor ldan nor gyi blo gros ma/ /nor 'dzin ma dang dbyig ldan ma/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can kun gzod ma/ /gser ldan la sogs sa gzhi'i ming*/ /'jug bya 'jug ngogs 'gro ba'i gzhi/ /bgrod lam srol lam lam gyi ming*/ /gnas gzhi khang khyim 'dug nas dang*/ /sdum ra khang ba spyi yi ming*/ khang mchog pho brang gzhal med khang*/ khang chen la sogs khang bzang ming*/ /gan+dho la dang dri gtsang khang*/ /gtsug lag khang sogs lha khang ming*/ /sa 'dzin dbang bo ri yi dbang*/ /ri rgyal ri rab lhun po'i ming*/ /sa 'dzin rdul brtsegs rtse mo can/ /gyen brtsegs sa phur ri spyi'i ming*/ /kai la sha dang kha ba'i ri/ /bsil ri gangs ldan gangs ri'i ming*/ /gdong lnga ba dang kha lnga ba/ /ri dwags rgyal bo ri dwags dbang*/ /gcan gzan rgyal bo sder chags rje/ /'phrog byed la sogs seng ge'i ming*/ /gnyis 'thung lag ldan mche ba can/ /sna ring la sogs glang bo'i ming*/ /mkha' spyod 'dab ldan sgo nga skyes/ /gnyis skyes sgro ldan bya spyi'i ming*/ /mkha' spyod dbang bo mkha' lding dbang*/ /nam mkha' lding dbang khyung gi ming*/ /dpyid kyi pho nya ngag snyan dang*/ /ku hu la sogs khu byug ming*/ /mdongs ldan gar mkhan mjug sgro can/ /gtsug phud can sogs rma bya'i ming*/ /mi pho skyes bu skyes pa pho/ /mi mo bud med skyes dman mo/ khye'u byis pa bu chung ming*/ /lang tsho bde gzhon dar ma'i ming*/ /rgas khog lo lon rgan po'i ming*/ /yan lag dang po yan lag mchog /yan lag thog ma mgo yi ming*/ / mgo skyes mgo spu skra yi ming*/ /lta byed mthong byed mig gi ming*/ /sgra 'dzin thos 'dzin rna ba'i ming*/ /dri len dri 'dzin sna yi ming*/

/ro myong ro 'dzin lce yi ming*/ /gcod byed gnyis skyes so yi ming*/ /ngag sgo smra sgo kha yi ming*/ /pho dbang pho rtags pho mtshan ming*/ /bha ga pad+ma mo rtags ming*/ /'og sgo bshang lam rkub kyi ming*/ /mi dbang sa skyong mi yi bdag /sa dbang sa spyod dpon gyi ming*/ khrims ldan bslab ldan tshangs spyod ldan/ /brtul zhugs can sogs tshul khrims ldan/ /bya btang bya bral ri khrod pa/ /rnal 'byor can sogs sgom byed ming*/ /blo ldan gsal ldan smra mkhas dang*/ /dpyod ldan thos ldan mkhas pa'i ming*/ /brtul phod stobs ldan pha rol gnon/ /thub dka' dpal ldan dpa' bo'i ming*/ /dha nu gnam ru gzhu yi ming*/ /sgro ldan nyag phran mda' yi ming*/ /ljon pa ljon shing rkang 'thung shing*/ /gor ma sra mkhreg rdo ba rdo/ /nags klung nags mthongs nags tshal nags/ /sa yi snying bo sa le sbram/ /rin chen mchog sogs gser gyi ming*/ /des mtshon gzhan yang grangs med kyang*/ / 'dir ni nye bar mkho tsam las/ /mtha' dag brjod par mi lang phyir/ /rigs pa yis ni dpag par bya// //na mo ār+ya lo ke shwa ra ye/ gsum pa brda yi khyad par ni/ /brda rnying kwa gag te phor rnams/ /gsar bcad kyis ni bcos pa'i tshul/ /kye dang gang dang shin tu zer/ /bla 'og spyi bo bla kyal bar/ /steng 'og rtse mo mi zad zer/ /dpung po rtsa lag zhig gu la/ /phung po gnyen dang ston pa zer/ /gnya' bo rid pa skyo skyor la/ /dpang bo sgem pa yang yang zer/ /'phya ba ye 'byam ngo ga la/ /smod pa stong nyid snang ngo zer/ /dpal dang ga zha ya lad la/ /tog dang bzhad gad go cha zer/ /gna' dang cog dang phyi mo la/ /thog ma mtha' dag rtsa ba zer/ /spyi bur gsang khung 'o cog la/ /byi bo bshang lam ma lus zer/ /mdung dor cham du nod pa la/ /rgyan 'byed gtan du thob pa zer/ /bsti ba brnag pa rmyang ba la/ /ngal so 'bad pa brkyang ba zer/ /nam zhar gzhur dang 'on tang la/

/nam yang gzhung dang 'on kyang zer/ /bkri ba dbrag dang gzags pa la/ /drang ba bar dang zag pa zer/ /phyam chad bgro ba mtshan ma la/ /mnyam nyid gleng ba rtags ces zer/ /mngag pa rma ga chad pa la/ /pho nya yang dag pa zhes zer/ /bstar ba gting phyir gting ring la/ /gzab pa dpyis phyin zab mo zer/ khro dang tha mar bsnyil ba la/ /mna' dang ngan pa dor ba zer/ /je dang gzhi bo ji 'os la/ /dang po gzhi ma 'tsham pa zer/ /gnod pa bkur bar mi byed la/ /nyes pa khas mi len zhes zer/ /gzon pa 'chab pa 'dzan dka' la/ /mi nyan sbed pa sbyor dka' zer/ 'khu ba bcabs pa bcil ba la/ /sdang ba sbed pa bcom pa zer/ /gya tshom gzan pa rna blags la/ /ma brtags gsan pa rna gtad zer/ /tha chad 'phye ba smrang tshig la/ /ngan pa 'gro ba gsang tshig zer/ /mi 'jab bshung ba dral pa la/ /rtsub pa 'khang pa chag pa zer/ /bla mthang bsod pa brim pa la/ /stod smad bzang bo bstam pa zer/ /'brim pa drug pa 'drub pa la/ /ster ba grub pa sgrub pa zer/ /brtsur ba byer ba dmus pa la/ /bsu ba sod pa smon pa zer/ /brtas pa da ko 'di ko la/ /rgyas pa da ni 'di ni zer/ /bkon pa ji ga gzhol ba la/ khro ba brtag pa 'bab pa zer/ /tha ba gzhar yang bshos pa la/ /nyon mongs nam yang 'khrig pa zer/ / gar yang mnos pa red pa la/ / gang yang bsam pa 'grub pa zer/ /lung dang mgo mnyam gya nom la/ /rtags dang dus mnyam phun tshogs zer/ /sdum pa pog dang pog phor la/ khang pa sbos dang sbos phor zer/ /phyad pa she stag rngub pa la/ /rgyun du sha stag 'dus pa zer/ /tsham ngam bab chol snam lo gsal/ /'jigs stangs ma bsam zur du zer/ khos rang chab mi 'tshal ba la/ /'dun ma chud mi za ba zer/ /yug pa sug pa nem nur la/ /rkang ba lag pa yid gnyis zer/ /rgya cang gor bu gyi na la/ /ska rags zlum po ngan pa zer/ kho lag brtad pa mi yogs la/ /chu zheng glo bur mi khebs zer/ /ji rob nyon mongs bskyud pa la/ /ci phyir sdug bsngal brjed pa zer/

khad kyis byur dang gtugs pa la/ / dal bus mya ngan zad pa zer/ /yol go 'gyod pa bsnyengs pa la/ /gzhongs pa phangs pa 'jigs pa zer/ /'ubs pa chub pa la gol la/ /'dus pa rtogs pa 'gyogs pa zer/ /mur 'dug thal byung mtho 'tsham la/ /mu stegs ma lus co 'dri zer/ khos pa mos pa gyin 'da' la/ /'dun ma gtam dang rang bzhin zer/ /nyag phran gor ma chag pa la/ /mda' dang the tshom med pa zer/ /gnam ru sbog dkar bkam pa la/ /gzhu dang spos dkar chags pa zer/ /brdub pa sgrug pa gzhur brtag la/ /'jug pa zad pa zur za zer/ /phyar g.yeng bab chod dam pa la/ /rnam g.yeng 'jug pa rngams pa zer/ /sgam pa gsos pa mnab pa la/ / zab pa dral ba gyon pa zer/ /mchig gu tshar phyin dbab pa la/ /gtun dang mthar phyin bzhag pa zer/ /gyad dang gzas dang phon po la/ /stobs dang sta gon tshogs pa zer/ /brdos pa 'dzer ba 'chel pa la/ /gzung ba smra ba zhen pa zer/ /gla la bklubs pa g.yem pa la/ /gdangs pa gyon pa 'dod pa zer/ /mu cor khor zug bgam pa la/ /brdzun pa khor yug nyams sad zer/ /go 'dun zhe'o mchi ba la/ /gang mos zer ro lcags kyu zer/ /'gyer ba rum dang rmel ba la/ /spong ba lto ba khel ba zer/ /'phyo ba 'gems pa spun pa la/ /lding ba 'joms pa brdzun pa zer/ /snyugs bsring dbrog pa glebs pa la/ /rgyun bsring 'phrog pa mnan pa zer/ /rjen pa gal gyis bgom pa la/ /gcer bu dal gyis 'gro ba zer/ /rlugs pa nongs pa 'phye bo la/ /lug pa nyes pa gong bo zer/ /'grem pa gsong po mkhyud pa la/ /'gyed pa drang po spas pa zer/ /spyi tor can dang do ker la/ /gtsug tor can dang thor cog zer/ /mur thug mi cha gtol med la/ /mthar thug mi shes thabs med zer/ /ci kar ci chib gar cig la/ /ci ltar mthar phyin gang zhig zer/ /dmun pa sho be shid zan la/ /blun pa brdzun dang ro zan zer/ /phru ma brtun pa sgo 'phar la/ /sgar dang brtson pa sgo glegs zer/

/spyos pa dbye tshong bslan pa la/ /bsdigs pa tshong khang bsdus pa zer/ /rmed med g.yon spyo rmed pa la/ /gtan med co 'dri gsol ba zer/ /slong phor bro 'tshal bya ma rtar/ /lhung bzed nad pa pho nya zer/ /gtsug lag bshad pa go re la/ /sde snod bshad pa rdzogs pa zer/ /brlang po gzhogs stegs shur bu la/ /rtsub pa sgeg chos ska rags zer/ /'dzan mo 'jud mthun 'thab bkrol la/ /bud med smad 'tshong 'thab 'khrugs zer/ /pus mkhyud brngan pa 'brongs pa la/ /sgom thag mchod pa nyer bsten zer/ /gor slar rol ya ma brlar/ /btson ra phyi rol mi bden zer/ /gel ba reng bu me 'gong la/ /yal ga rkyang ba mi zhum zer/ /than kor po ga rem stes la/ /nye 'khor ba gam ma legs zer/ /stes dbang gna' bo mi gu la/ /stabs legs sngon dang mi zhum zer/ /gzha' tshon rmongs rtul chu brub la/ /'ja' tshon blun po chu 'khrugs zer/ /gzha' gsang phyal 'phrul dbu rmog la/ /g.yung drung rna rgyan dbu 'phang zer/ /'drid dang 'phong dang nyi tshe la/ /slu ba 'phen dang phyogs re zer/ /gzod ma ril dang 'dzeg pa la/ /dang po thams cad 'phrad pa zer/ /gzu lum klong du gyur ba la/ /rang bzo dbang du gyur ba zer/ /gnod ba dong dang 'dod pa la/ /nyes pa song dang 'gro ba zer/ /jis dang blod cing gzhog pa la/ /jis na brjod cing 'jog pa zer/ /kos thag btung bcil gyin dang la/ /nyam thag sbyangs pa rgyu med zer/ /snga mkho bsnyur te kha sbon la/ /snga ma myur du kha ton zer/ /'o ni 'on cig dben pa la/ /'di ni byin cig yid 'ong zer/ /nying tor byos shig rangs pa la/ /nges par gyis shig dga' bde zer/ /bya skon gnyig tu 'ong 'ga' la/ /bya rgya gcig tu res 'ga' zer/ /rgya rna ru dang mchis 'brang la/ /mi tshangs spyod dang chung ma zer/ /gzhongs dang nan tur yur te la/ / ljongs dang chad las bden te zer/ /dmas pa slad bzhen 'or cig la/ /

nyams pa phyir bzhin bor cig zer/ /yur dang sbu gu spre'u chung la/ /gnyid dang bu ga 'dzag snod zer/ /bar ta gtan pa kog tshe la/ /stan 'bol sra brkyang rnyi thag zer/ /'phyan pa gshor ba par tang la/ /'khyam pa rtsub pa stan khra zer/ /mdongs pa dmigs pu nye reg pa/ /long ba long 'khrid khrus zhes zer/ /g.yam la yal gad skon bu dang*/ /zhar la rkang rten gzhong bu zer/ /skyo dogs bags kyis nod pa la/ /'khrugs pa rim gyis len pa zer/ /gzar thag shul du mad pa la/ /dbyangs thag lam du bden pa zer/ /bkad sa brlams pa sgre bo la/ /'dug sa bskyod pa sa rjen zer/ /tshig gu phyag brnyan pho long la/ / 'bras bu 'khor dang dru gu zer/ /bar 'ga' gor ma 'chums pa la/ /res 'ga' rdo dang chags pa zer/ /ma la tshang ngam g.yar dam la/ /kye ma me khang dam bca' zer/ /bus pa g.yar ngo sge'u chung la/ /byis pa gdong dang 'gro ba zer/ / g.yar khral g.yar 'dren g.yar dam la/ kha khral spyan 'dren mdun du zer/ / rtsen pa bla gab smon 'grim la/ /rtse ba steng g.yogs grogs po zer/ /thog thog re zig bon pa la/ /dang po zin bris bzlas pa zer/ /ne'u ldang ke'u kun dong la/ /na zla ri sgog btsong zhes zer/ /mi ngas sbal du btsum pa la/ /mi nad dong du 'o byed zer/ /zhal tshun ldum bu 'khos phab la/ /zhal zas shing tog logs bzhag zer/ /phyogs dang bgros pa mol ba la/ khri dang gleng ba gros pa zer/ / bstang ba mi 'gong dgyel che la/ /grogs dang mi skrag khongs yangs zer/ / bsgrub pa sgrun pa 'jungs pa las/ /bskyed pa 'gran pa chags pa zer/ / gdugs dang rtul phod rlam khyer la/ /nyin mo dpa' ba ham khyer zer/ /ma rtabs phyang de don mthun la/ /ma tshab 'jol le tshong ba zer/ /la gcan pa dang sho gam la/ /la tshugs pa dang gru tshugs zer/ /bzlums pa chu lon ka ca la/ / bsdus pa chu rags dngos po zer/ /gzhes pa nye zho med pa la/ /bzhugs pa skyon sogs med ces zer/

/de la sogs pa ches mang yang*/ /mtha' dag su zhig brjod par nus/ /cha tsam dbus pa blo gsal dang*/ /skyogs ston la sogs mkhas pa yi/ /man ngag dag la brten nas ni/ /legs par bshad pa'i rnam dkar dges/ /'gro rnams rmongs pa'i sgrib bral nas/ /kun mkhyen ye shes thob gyur cig /ces snyan ngag mngon brjod brda'i khyad par mdor bsdus pa 'di yang*/ bstan pa'i mnga' bdag ko'u shri yes zhal snga nas rang nyid kyis tshul 'di dag la legs par sbyangs pa sngon du btang ba'i tshe/ 'di gsum gyi rnam gzhag cung zad cig bris na/ phyogs 'dir don gnyer can re gnyis la phan srid ces bkas bskul zhing*/ gzhan gyis kyang bskul ba'i ngor shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis g.yar khral tsam du bris pa ste/ 'on kyang*/ gzu bor gnas pa'i dad ldan gyis/ /legs bshad mthong na mgu mod kyi/ /phyogs lhung can gyi skye bo la/ /yid kyi tsher mar 'gyur yang srid/ /gla rtsis dug ni sel byed kyang*/ / dug sbrul gyis ni 'dod dam ci/ /zhes kyang smras so/ /bkra shis// //
